title: 날씨 앱 읽기: 우산이 필요해요? 마스크가 필요해요?
summary: Read a Korean weather app forecast and say whether you need an umbrella or a mask, with a reason.
objective: Learners can find the temperature, chance of rain, and dust levels on a Korean weather app. They can answer '우산이 필요해요?' or '마스크를 써야 해요?' with yes or no and a one-sentence reason.

sections.heading: The app screen
paragraphs: Read this weather app screen. All the questions use it.

sections.heading: Words on the screen
paragraphs: Learn the words that appear on the weather app screen.

items.text: the lowest, i.e. the low temperature for the day.
items.exampleMeaning: In the morning it's 12 degrees, the low for the day.

items.text: the highest, i.e. the high temperature for the day.
items.exampleMeaning: In the afternoon it reaches 23 degrees.

items.text: the chance of rain or snow. It is pronounced [강수황뉼].

items.exampleMeaning: There's a lot of fine dust today.

items.text: ultrafine dust, i.e. even smaller particles (PM2.5). The app shows this as a separate line.
(joeum / botong / nappeum / maeu nappeum) good / moderate / bad / very bad. These are the dust levels, from best to worst.
face mask. We say 마스크를 써요 (to wear a mask).

sections.heading: From the screen to speech
paragraphs: The app uses short labels. When you speak, change them into sentences: 좋음 → 좋아요, 보통 → 보통이에요, 나쁨 → 나빠요, 매우 나쁨 → 매우 나빠요.
Example: the screen says 미세먼지 나쁨, so you say 미세먼지가 나빠요.

aside.title: Pronunciation notes
lines: Read temperatures with Sino-Korean numbers + 도: 12° = 십이 도, 23° = 이십삼 도.

sections.heading: Answering: yes or no + a reason
paragraphs: Use these rules to answer the questions on this worksheet.

cards.title: Umbrella rule
cards.text: Say yes when the chance of rain is 60% or more.
cards.example:
우산이 필요해요?
→ 네, 필요해요. / 아니요, 필요 없어요.

cards.title: Mask rule
cards.text: Say yes when either 미세먼지 or 초미세먼지 is 나쁨 or 매우 나쁨.
cards.example:
마스크를 써야 해요?
→ 네, 써야 해요. / 아니요, 안 써도 돼요.

panels.title: Model answers
lines: 마스크를 써야 해요? → 아니요, 안 써도 돼요. 초미세먼지가 좋아요.

panels.title: Full example
lines: 오늘 우산이 필요해요? → 아니요, 필요 없어요. 강수확률이 10%예요.

sections.note: Check both dust lines, not just one. Some days 미세먼지 is 보통 but 초미세먼지 is 나쁨.

task.line: Look at the app screen on page 1, find the information, and answer in Korean.

exercises: Look at the app screen and answer: 오늘 최저 기온하고 최고 기온은 몇 도예요?
Look at the app screen and answer: 내일 강수확률은 몇 퍼센트예요?
Answer with yes or no and give a reason: 내일 우산이 필요해요?
Answer with yes or no and give a reason: 오늘 마스크를 써야 해요?
Answer with yes or no and give a reason: 내일 마스크를 써야 해요?
answers: 아니요, 안 써도 돼요. 미세먼지하고 초미세먼지가 좋아요.
